about_the_game:
Game overview:

This is a classic casual minesweeper game that stands out with its cute painting style and exquisite character design. A girl with unique charm is unlocked after every 10 levels, for a total of 60 levels. Each girl has a unique personality and charm, waiting for players to challenge and unlock.

story background:

You are a young man who loves solving puzzles and challenges. One day you accidentally meet a group of girls with different personalities and charms. In order to win their favor and the opportunity to date, you embark on a minesweeper challenge journey. Every time you pass 10 levels of minesweeper challenges, you will unlock a new girl and start an exciting date journey with her.

Game features:

Classic minesweeper gameplay: Challenge your intelligence and strategy to solve the puzzles in each level.

Cute painting style: Fresh and cute game graphics make every girl full of vivid personality and charm.

Diverse dating stories: Each girl has her own unique story and background waiting for you to explore and unlock.

"Challenge the classic minesweeper and unlock the heart of the girl you like!"
